description: Configure Couchbase cluster connection profiles used by the Couchbase() function.

id.description: Unique profile ID passed to Couchbase().

connection_string.description: Couchbase connection string, for example couchbase://db.example.com or couchbases://db.example.com.

username.description: Username used to authenticate with the cluster.

password.description: Password used to authenticate with the cluster.
